Forklift Advanced

First, we should install the forklift accessories. Click here to jump to the Forklift Assembly section in Car_Assembly.

1. Integrated Demo_V1

Effect: Based on our previous lessons, the vehicle utilizes various sensors and control methods to create an integrated demonstration program that showcases the vehicle’s multiple functions. (Includes customizable music for instruction)

Effect demonstration:

makecode program link: https://makecode.microbit.org/S81815-15231-85946-91749

Screenshot of makecode graphical interface:

Code analysis:

  • on start shows an icon once. The main demonstration is one long sequence inside forever, so it starts again after reaching the bottom.

  • At the beginning of the sequence, servo S1 goes to 0 degrees and the car moves forward at speed 125.

  • The program changes the searchlights and bottom RGB lights while it plays the notes shown in the blocks. The until done setting means each note finishes before the next block runs.

  • During the sequence, the car also moves backward, rotates left, and rotates right. These later movement blocks use speed 255.

  • Servo S1 is moved to 0, 90, and 180 degrees at different points in the sequence.

  • At the end, the car stops, the searchlights are turned off, the RGB lights are set to black, and servo S1 returns to 90 degrees. Then the demonstration repeats.

13. Infrared Remote Control

Effect: An optional infrared receiver module is installed at the front of the car. This allows the car to receive signals from an infrared remote control via programming, and different buttons can be pressed to control the car’s direction and speed, achieving a remote control effect. (This also incorporates elements from previous tutorials.)

Effect demonstration:

makecode program link: https://makecode.microbit.org/S97076-50786-20847-48807

Screenshot of makecode graphical interface:

Code analysis:

  • At the start, the infrared receiver is connected to pin P8. Servo S1 and the variable a are both set to 90.

  • Pressing OK stops the car. Up moves forward at speed 100 for 200 milliseconds and then stops; Down does the same in reverse.

  • LEFT and RIGHT rotate the car at speed 100 for 150 milliseconds and then stop. NUM1 and NUM3 also start left and right rotation, but their blocks do not include a pause or a stop.

  • NUM4 sets the RGB lights to violet, while NUM6 sets them to black. NUM7 sets the searchlights to white, while NUM9 turns them off.

  • NUM2 subtracts 15 from a and NUM8 adds 15. The checks keep a between 0 and 180, and servo S1 moves to the new angle.

  • STAR subtracts 180 and moves S1 to 0 degrees. GRID adds 180 and moves S1 to 180 degrees. The same 0-to-180 limits are applied.

  • NUM5 plays the built-in baddy melody. NUM0 shows 0 for 100 milliseconds and then clears the LED screen.
